scope: Saved historical 32-bit SHA-256 compression pairs at 36-39 rounds. Both messages share a chosen nonstandard input chaining value. Not standard-IV hash collisions, legal-padding certificates, novel discoveries, minimum-condition proofs or attack-price claims.
reference_comparison: Only witnesses.json, recovered31.json and pairs39.json were semantically compared. Absence there does not prove absence elsewhere in the library.
reuse: Project research data prepared at the owner request; no blanket license is asserted.
